| **M-60** | **Evaluator hardening rules (2026-10-07, hardening lane after the Phase 2 red-team and oracle B; provisional and conservative, operator ratification owed).** (a) **Absence (rule 7a)** returns `unregulated` only when no unit of any by-law layer carries the target (keyed or pending) and the lot's exception and every exception in its INCLUDE closure is authored for the target (`authored` / `partial` listing the target, every unit non-pending); otherwise `not_evaluated:exception_not_authored:<exception>` (new closed code).
